why_the_later_pool_dispatch_works.measurement: agent_teams_create_task at 16:40:50.814Z -> Reviewer's inbox splice 16:40:50.916Z -> Reviewer turn/start 2 at 16:40:50.918Z: 0.1 s end to end.
why_the_later_pool_dispatch_works.explanation: Identical code path; the only difference is the predicate. Reviewer was idle at that moment, so `isMemberAvailable` (pre-fix) / the new `memberActivity` returned available and the delivery went out immediately. At the approval instant the same predicate is provably false for every member because all of them are inside the turn that their own spawn started. So 'works later, silent at approval' is fully explained by WHEN the kick runs versus WHEN the spawn turns begin — not by two different dispatch mechanisms.
